problem:
$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}2 & -5 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}]x(t)
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above.
Find the unknown function $f(t)$ in the general solution to the system, shown below.

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2\operatorname{cos}⁡t-\operatorname{sin}⁡t \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡t\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}f(t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡t\end{aligned}]
$$

*Hint: The matrix has the eigenvalue ${\lambda }_{1}=\text{i}$ with the corresponding eigenvector ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2+\text{i} \\ 1\end{aligned}].$*

activity_context.topic_title: Solving Homogeneous Systems of ODEs With Complex Eigenvalues
